prompt:
Edit the attached time-zone map. This is a precise cartographic edit, not a reinterpretation.

KEEP EXACTLY AS-IS
- The same projection, framing and crop.
- Every coastline and every border in its exact current position and shape.
- The flat, hard-edged pixel rendering: solid fills, crisp black borders, no gradients, no shading, no texture, no noise, no drop shadows, no 3D.
- The white ocean background.
- EVERY place name and country name exactly as it is written now: same spelling, same position, same size, same capitalisation, same colour. Do not move, restyle, re-letter or re-space any name. Do not add names.
- Every small dot or circle marking a city.

REMOVE COMPLETELY
- Every clock-time label and the coloured box behind it (for example "18:45", "09:47", "23:46").
- Every yellow "DST" badge.
- Every time-zone abbreviation block (for example "CEST", "EAT", "MSK", "AEST", "PDT", "UTC+3", "MSK+2", "GMT", "WAT", "CAT", "TRT").
- The date boxes and the "UTC" box.
- The "Map outline WorldTimeZone.com / (C)WorldTimeZone All Rights reserved" box.
- Any grey rounded frame, border chrome or drop shadow around the edge of the image.
- Replace everything removed with the map colour that belongs underneath it.

Change nothing else. Do not recolour anything in this pass.
